description: Blacks out the rest of the monitor, taskbar included, around a windowed game, centred without its title bar.
pre_uninstall: if ($uninstall.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "GameBackdrop --uninstall failed (exit code $($uninstall.ExitCode)), so Game Backdrop is still installed. Fix what it said, then run scoop uninstall game-backdrop again." }
